newsitem.title: USA: American Physicians, FPIC in pact.
newsitem.headline: American Physicians, FPIC in pact.

text.p: American Physicians Services Group Inc said Friday it has formed an alliance with FPIC Insurance Group Inc.

The company said it formed the alliance to expand its presence in the Texas market for medical professional liability insurance. American Physicians chairman Ken Shifrin said the alliance with FPIC "brings the size, strength and geographical diversity that some providers require."

American Physicians is an Austin-based maagement and financial services firm that provides medical malpractice insurance services for doctors, brokerage and investment services to institutions and individuals, and computer systems for medical clinics, medical schools and physicians networks.
